profile.headline: Dedicated to ethical and sustainable software and farming practices

profile.summary:
Interested in IoT, blockchain technology, VR/AR, and the ethics behind technology.

I also have an interest in homesteading and farming using environmentally sustainable methods.

If you have an interesting opportunity I’d be a fit for and want to reach out, include the word “vermiculture” in your message and I’ll guarantee a response.

For a complete listing of projects made at hackathons, visit https://devpost.com/Nouser76 . All posts are entirely my own opinion and not those of any employers past or present.

positions.description: Increasingly, Amazon customers want knowledge about the products they purchase: that they were produced responsibly, and that the people in our supply chains, fulfillment centers, and transportation networks were treated fairly. Amazon’s Social Responsibility Technology Team applies Amazon’s technical breadth and depth to solve this problem.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Work on Product Replenishment Team.

The Subscribe and Save organization owns the technology platform to enable customers to easily order replenishable products on Amazon. We own platform services that support Recurring Delivery programs like Subscribe & Save for customers and Recurring Delivery for businesses. Our systems enable Amazon to launch high-profile, customer-facing programs that span multiple Amazon categories, technologies, and countries.

volunteerExperiences.description: I worked with a team to help organize, fundraise for, and execute a 24 hour event held at Penn State where people would create a software or hardware project from scratch in the 24 hours, then present it in a science fair-styled expo. I additionally gave a workshop on Unity3D development with a focus on virtual reality as well as blockchain technology,

Volunteered at CodeDay Seattle and helped students with Android and Unity questions, as well as general programming questions. Organized and ran Slideshow Karaoke activity for the students to break up the day.

projects.title: VaxCheck
projects.description: VaxCheck implements a blockchain that holds immunization data with a unique health key and verifies if immunization records are valid. To make sure that vaccinations are completely verified, a doctors office would upload patient data to the block chain and if an institution would want to retrieve the data they would be given a private key. Once they have the private key they would go on our website and all blocks for that institution are decrypted, allowing them to access the medical data safely and securely. Created with a Python server running Bottle for a hand-made blockchain for the backend and HTML/CSS and client-side JavaScript for the front-end.

projects.title: Fake Urban Dictionary Bot
projects.description: Used a dataset of all entries from Urban Dictionary to train a Markov model for automated Tweet generation. Allowed users to tweet @UrbDicBot (now defunct) to define any arbitrary term using this trained Markov model.
